product.title: Great Barrier Reef Adventure from Cairns including Snorkeling

description.text: In Cairns, this Great Adventures day leaves Reef Fleet Terminal by fast catamaran for an Outer Reef activity platform with snorkeling, a semi-submersible, and an underwater observatory. The published block lists about three hours at the platform plus buffet lunch rather than a sailing lagoon stop at Upolu Reef. The format suits visitors who want pontoon facilities and reef education without a VIP lounge upgrade. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Cairns, and the itinerary stays on Reef Fleet Terminal and the Outer Reef platform that define this outing rather than a Michaelmas Cay beach landing.

highlights: Fast catamaran from Cairns Reef Fleet Terminal
Buffet lunch with morning and afternoon tea

start.description: Check in at the Great Adventures counter inside Cairns Reef Fleet Terminal, 1 Spence Street.

end.description: Return to the Cairns meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
